scope_disposition: Outside scope only graphify-out/** (80 generated index/cache files; worker ran `graphify update .` per project CLAUDE.md). Derived navigation output, not product/test input; accepted by Root, will be regenerated at unit integration. Future packets forbid graphify update by leaves.
design: poll(): waitid(P_PID, WEXITED|WNOHANG|WNOWAIT) -> while zombie pins pid/sid, pin session members by pidfd (stat before/after equal, live) -> waitpid reap. /proc scan only when ownership proven by unreaped leader (ppid==backend, start ticks) or a pinned anchor member live and in-session before and after the scan. close(): killpg only on unreaped proven child; grace wait uses WNOWAIT; SIGKILL only through pinned pidfds; anchor kept until last; all pin fds closed. SESSION_PIN_LIMIT=256.
known_limits: After reap, if all pinned members die and only unpinned members remain, they are left (unprovable -> skip, C-D45); a child forked by the last anchor just before its kill may also remain.
residue: no processes; /tmp/cw03-g2-* 11 -> 13 (g2 suite, unattributed pattern, untouched)
